Description: Full tear-off and re-roofing project consisting of both sloped and flat roof sections located at 1218 Burnett St, Berkeley, CA. The sloped section includes removing existing materials down to the deck and installing synthetic underlayment, 30-year composition shingles (cool roof), new 26-gauge galvanized sheet metal, flashings, components, and new aluminum gutters and downspouts. The flat section involves a complete tear-off, installing a 1/8" per foot taper insulation system to ensure proper drainage, 1/4" Prime DensDeck, a self-adhesive base sheet, a one-ply granulated cap sheet, and all necessary plumbing jacks, drains, and roof scuppers.
